name: Voxkin
subtitle: Voice for your OpenClaw agent
description:
Your voice. Your gateway. Your choice of AI.

Voxkin is a privacy-focused voice client for your own OpenClaw setup. Talk to your agent from your iPhone without routing conversations through a Voxkin-hosted AI backend. Connect directly to the gateway you choose, using the agents, models, tools, and speech services configured there.

YOUR SETUP, NOT ANOTHER AI SERVICE
Voxkin does not add its own external AI or speech provider to your conversations. Your gateway controls which services handle requests. Use local services or cloud providers configured by you or your gateway administrator. No advertising SDK. No app analytics SDK. No Voxkin-hosted AI subscription required.

PRIVATE ACCESS FROM AWAY FROM HOME
Use Tailscale to reach your home gateway over a private VPN connection, without making the gateway publicly accessible. Tailscale is optional, installed separately, and requires your own network setup. Voxkin connects to your gateway using encrypted connections; credentials are stored in device-only iOS Keychain storage.

SPEAK OR TYPE
Tap to talk and hear spoken answers, or use the keyboard when you prefer. Speech recognition runs on your iPhone where supported, with no cloud recognition fallback. Stop playback or request cancellation of an active turn.

CARPLAY VOICE CONVERSATIONS
Talk to your agent through CarPlay on iOS 26.4 or later. Start conversations explicitly, hear spoken replies, and stop or cancel from the CarPlay interface. Complete gateway setup on your iPhone before driving.

CHOOSE YOUR VOICE
Use your gateway's configured speech service. The optional Voxkin gateway plugin adds local English and Spanish voices, language selection, and voice previews. On-device dictation availability depends on your iPhone and language setup.

INVITE ANOTHER PHONE
With the compatible plugin and gateway administrator approval, invite a phone to use an assigned agent. Restricted connections support conversation and voice, not agent tools. Gateway and network access must be arranged separately.

KNOW WHERE YOUR DATA GOES
Recognized text goes to your chosen gateway. That gateway may use configured external model, speech, or tool services. Direct connection does not mean all processing is local: those services and your gateway operator determine their own storage and retention. Clearing the phone's view does not delete gateway history.

REQUIRES YOUR OWN GATEWAY ACCESS
You need a compatible OpenClaw gateway that you own or have permission to use. Voxkin does not include a hosted AI assistant. Gateway hosting, Tailscale, and configured third-party services may have separate requirements or costs.

AI responses may be inaccurate. Verify important information. Voxkin is not an emergency service.
promotionalText: Your voice, your OpenClaw gateway, your configured AI. No Voxkin-hosted AI backend. Connect privately from home or away with your own Tailscale setup.
